[[File:StroppelPrinceton.jpg|thumb|Stroppel in Princeton, 2008]]
'''Catharina Stroppel''' (born 1971)<ref>Birth year from [http://d-nb.info/gnd/1077764553 German National Library catalog entry], retrieved 2018-12-02.</ref> is a German mathematician whose research concerns [[representation theory]], [[low-dimensional topology]], and [[category theory]]. She is a professor of mathematics at the [[University of Bonn]], and vice-coordinator of the [[Hausdorff Center for Mathematics]] in Bonn.<ref name="hcm">{{citation|url=https://www.hcm.uni-bonn.de/people/profile/catharina-stroppel/|title=HCM People: Prof. Dr. Catharina Stroppel|publisher=[[Hausdorff Center for Mathematics]]|accessdate=2016-05-13}}.</ref><ref name="uni-bonn">{{citation|url=http://www.math.uni-bonn.de/ag/stroppel/|title=Catharina Stroppel: Mathematisches Institut, Universitaet Bonn|publisher=[[University of Bonn]]|accessdate=2016-05-13}}.</ref>

== Education and career==
Stroppel earned a diploma in mathematics and theology from the [[University of Freiburg]] in 1998.<ref name="uni-bonn"/> She completed her doctorate, also from the University of Freiburg, in 2001, under the supervision of Wolfgang Soergel.<ref>{{mathgenealogy|id=58328}}</ref> After short-term positions at the [[University of Leicester]] and [[Aarhus University]], she joined the [[University of Glasgow]] as a research associate in 2004, and was promoted to lecturer in 2005 and reader in 2007. In 2008 she moved to Bonn as a professor.<ref name="uni-bonn"/>

== Awards and honors ==
In 2007, the [[London Mathematical Society]] awarded Stroppel their [[Whitehead Prize]] "for her contributions to representation theory, in particular in the framework of categorifications and its applications to low-dimensional topology".<ref>{{citation|url=https://www.ams.org/notices/200709/tx070901164p.pdf|department=Mathematics People|journal=[[Notices of the American Mathematical Society]]|title=Prizes of the London Mathematical Society|pages=1164–1165|volume=54|issue=9|date=October 2007}}.</ref> She was an invited speaker at the 2010 [[International Congress of Mathematicians]].<ref>{{citation|title=ICM Plenary and Invited Speakers since 1897|url=http://www.mathunion.org/db/ICM/Speakers/SortedByCongress.php|publisher=[[International Congress of Mathematicians]]|accessdate=2016-05-13|archive-date=8 November 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171108012153/http://www.mathunion.org/db/ICM/Speakers/SortedByCongress.php|url-status=dead}}</ref> In 2018, she became a member of the [[German Academy of Sciences Leopoldina]].<ref>{{citation|url=https://www.leopoldina.org/en/members/list-of-members/list-of-members/member/Member/show/catharina-stroppel/|title=Catharina Stroppel|publisher=[[German Academy of Sciences Leopoldina]]|accessdate=2019-01-05}}</ref> She was named [[Mathematical Sciences Research Institute|MSRI]] Simons Professor for 2009–2010.<ref>{{Cite web|last=MSRI|title=Mathematical Sciences Research Institute|url=http://www.msri.org/|access-date=2021-06-07|website=www.msri.org}}</ref> She was awarded a 2023 [[Leibniz Prize|Gottfried Wilhelm Leibniz Prize]] “in recognition of her excellent work in representation theory, especially on the topic of category theory.”<ref>{{Cite web |title=American Mathematical Society |url=https://www.ams.org/journals/notices/202304/noti2676/noti2676.html |access-date=2023-04-08 |website=American Mathematical Society |language=en}}</ref>
